title: fix(lint): the flow and hook publish doors stop requiring a null guard on the current row's created_at and updated_at in an ordering comparison
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7LTHigm6QKzQQKhVRzksVQ)_

Fixes #33246

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the flow and hook publish doors (Studio, `/api/v1/meta`, the MCP and AI authoring doors) now accept a condition they refused and `os build` accepted: `created_at` or `updated_at` (as the registry injects them, on an object whose storage the platform provisions) read off the current row (bare in a flow, or `record.`) as an operand of `<`, `<=`, `>` or `>=` with no `!= null` guard, in a record-triggered flow or in a hook whose every event is `afterInsert`, `beforeUpdate`, `afterUpdate`, `beforeDelete` or `afterDelete`. Nothing that published before is refused, and no other verdict moves: arithmetic over either column, a `previous.` read, a `beforeInsert` or read-event hook, and the other six injected columns keep their verdicts (measured below). `os build`, `os validate`, `os lint` and MCP `validate_expression` are unchanged. No exported type or signature changes.
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none owed — no skill teaches that `created_at` or `updated_at` needs a null guard in a flow or hook condition, or that the door refuses one; the door now gives the verdict `os build` already gives on those two columns under an ordering comparison.

Precedent followed: #33154 (PR #33205) for the door-versus-build reading. Round 2 answered contract review 6884221427 under seat rulings 6884227999 (F1, F2, F3, N2; N1 declarations kept). Round 3 answered delta review 6884875891 under seat rulings 6884884180 (M1, S1, N3, N4, N5). Round 4 answers review 6885550922 under seat rulings 6885555312 (M2, S2, N6).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：运行时发布口（流、钩子）做“空值守卫”判定时，`created_at`、`updated_at` 作为比较运算（`<` `<=` `>` `>=`）的操作数不再报可空；仅限当前记录的这两列（流里的裸名或 `record.`，不含 `previous.`）、平台自己注入的定义、对象的存储由平台建表（外部对象不算），且钩子的每个事件都在 `afterInsert`、`beforeUpdate`、`afterUpdate`、`beforeDelete`、`afterDelete` 之内。算术运算（`+ - * / %`）、`previous.` 读取照旧判定；其它六个注入列（`owner_id`、`created_by`、`updated_by`、`owning_business_unit_id`、`queue`、`organization_id`）照旧按可空判定；所有注入列的类型判定照旧。
- **为什么改**：在 Studio 发布记录触发流或钩子时，条件 `record.created_at > timestamp(...)` 没加空值守卫会被发布口拒绝（422），而 `os build` 通过、MCP `validate_expression` 也说没问题。平台在 `beforeInsert`（`sys_stamp_audit_insert`，优先级 10）里给每条记录写这两列，之后读到的都有值，拒绝是误报。
- **风险与回滚**：放宽，只影响流和钩子发布口对这两列在比较运算中的空值判定。不变且有测试钉住的：流里 `record.created_at + 1 > 0` 与 `record.updated_at - record.created_at > duration('1h')` 照旧拒绝；`beforeInsert` 钩子照旧拒绝（可能先于平台写入运行）；读事件（`beforeFind`、`afterFind`）钩子照旧拒绝（没有记录）；`afterInsert` 钩子或新建流里的 `record.updated_at > previous.updated_at` 照旧拒绝（新建时 `previous` 为空）；其它六个注入列、作者自己声明的 `created_at`、外部对象照旧。发布口与 build 在六列及 `beforeInsert`、读事件钩子上的差异留给 #33435。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`（`PLATFORM_STAMPED_COLUMNS`、`isPlatformStampedColumn`、`buildPlatformStampedIndex`、`isStampedComparisonFinding`、`hookReadsStampedRow`）、`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-flow-hook-injected-column-null-guard.test.ts`（真实发布口）、`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts`（#33246 一节）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts -t 33246`，预期 10 条全过：两列无守卫比较在流三处与钩子都通过；五个可空注入列照旧拒绝；日期运算照旧拒绝（钩子、流裸写、动作）；流里 `record.` 写法的算术照旧拒绝；`beforeInsert` 钩子照旧拒绝；`previous.` 读取照旧拒绝；读事件钩子照旧拒绝；作者声明与外部对象的 `created_at` 照旧判定；声明的可空字段照旧拒绝。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`.**
  - `PLATFORM_STAMPED_COLUMNS` (`created_at`, `updated_at`) and `isPlatformStampedColumn(obj, field, def)`: true only when the field is one of the two, its definition is the platform's own (`isInjectedColumnDefinition` against `injectedSystemColumnDefs(obj)`), and the platform provisions the object's storage (`platformProvisionsStorage`, so not an ADR-0015 `external` object). The two names are the ones `@objectstack/objectql` stamps on every row (`sys_stamp_audit_insert`, a `beforeInsert` hook at priority 10, writes both unconditionally). This package may not import a runtime, so they are spelled here, with that reference in the docblock.
  - `buildPlatformStampedIndex(objects)` (object → its stamped columns) is built on every runtime write (`options.runtimeWriteType !== undefined`); the build gets an empty index. `buildNullableFieldIndex` is back to `main`'s signature and body: the nullable index still holds both columns.
  - `checkNullGuards` takes `{ stampedComparisons }` (default `true`) and drops a finding only when `isStampedComparisonFinding` holds: the operand is a stamped column of that object read off the current row (bare, as a record-triggered flow flattens its trigger record, or `record.<column>`), and the operator is `<`, `<=`, `>` or `>=`. A `previous.<column>` operand keeps its finding and `PREVIOUS_GUARD_CLAUSE` (M2): an insert binds `previous` itself to `null`. An arithmetic operand (`+ - * / %`) keeps its finding (M1): at a record-triggered flow's `record.` read the null guard is the door's only refusal of date arithmetic, because the flattened site type-checks only the bare spelling.
  - The hook loop passes `stampedComparisons: hookReadsStampedRow(hook.events)`: true only when `events` is a non-empty list and every event is `afterInsert`, `beforeUpdate`, `afterUpdate`, `beforeDelete` or `afterDelete`. A `beforeInsert` hook (S1) can run before the stamp, at any `priority`, and read either column as `null`; a `beforeFind` / `afterFind` hook (S2) carries no record.
  - The `object_extension` strip is `main`'s (only that write reads the objects stripped). Every other door keeps the served objects, so `fieldTypeIndex` and every other reader still see the injected columns' types.
  - Effect at the door: an unguarded ordering over `created_at` / `updated_at` at the three record-triggered flow sites and in a hook condition whose every event reads a stamped stored row publishes, when the read is the current row's. Everything else is judged as on `main`.
- **`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.test.ts`**: the #5017 declared-key meta-test's `hook` row now lists `events` (a declared `ObjectStackSchema.hooks[]` key), and its plumbing set names `platformStampedIndex` / `stamped` / `hookEvents` (Map / Set / Array locals). The meta-test forces that visit for any new read.
- **`.changeset/33246-door-skips-stamped-timestamps-in-comparisons.md`** (renamed from round 1's `33246-door-reads-objects-as-authored.md`): `@objectstack/lint` minor, both declaration lines, Before / Now / Unchanged. Unchanged names arithmetic at every door (the flow `record.` spelling included), the author-declared and `external` `created_at`, a `previous.` read, a `beforeInsert` or read-event hook, the six injected columns still judged nullable (`organization_id` included), and the door/build difference on those six and on a `beforeInsert` or read-event hook until #33435. Its Now paragraph gives the stamp as the warrant (N6).
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` does not describe the door's null-guard reading, so it is not edited.

## Tests

1. **`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts`**, top-level describe `#33246` (10 cases), at the gate (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, the account as the registry serves it via `applyInjectedSystemColumns`) and at the build (`runAuthoringRules('build', …)`). Five writes per condition: a flow with it at the start node, an edge and a `decision` branch; a hook on `'crm_account'` and on `['crm_account']`.
   - The served account declares the injected columns.
   - LIT: `record.created_at > timestamp('2025-01-01T00:00:00Z')` and `record.updated_at > record.created_at`: no expression finding at the door or the build.
   - LIT: `record.COLUMN > 'a'` for each of `owner_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue`: one null-guard finding naming the column at the door.
   - LIT (type verdict): `record.created_at + 1 > 0` and `record.updated_at - record.created_at > duration('1h')` at a hook, bare `created_at + 1 > 0` at a flow start and edge, and `record.created_at + 1 > 0` as an action `visible`: each refused with `date arithmetic`.
   - LIT (M1): `record.created_at + 1 > 0` and `record.updated_at - record.created_at > duration('1h')` at a flow start condition: each refused with a null-guard finding on the column.
   - LIT (S1): `record.created_at > timestamp(…)` on a hook with `events: ['beforeInsert']` and `['beforeInsert', 'beforeUpdate']`, on a string and a list `object`: refused with a null-guard finding; the same condition on an `afterInsert` hook: no finding.
   - LIT (M2): `record.updated_at > previous.updated_at` in an `afterInsert` hook and at a `record-after-create` flow start: one finding each, on `previous.updated_at`, whose message names `previous != null && previous.updated_at != null`.
   - LIT (S2): `record.created_at > timestamp(…)` on a hook with `events` `['beforeFind']`, `['afterFind']` and `['afterFind', 'afterUpdate']`: refused with a null-guard finding.
   - CONTROL: a `created_at` the author declares (own label) is judged at the door as at the build (deep-equal findings); the one on an `external` object is still judged at the door.
   - CONTROL: `record.amount > 0` (declared nullable) refused at the door with one finding, deep-equal to the build's.
2. **`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-flow-hook-injected-column-null-guard.test.ts`** (new; surface amendment 6884227999), the real door: better-sqlite3 behind the real `ObjectQL`, the real `sys_metadata*` objects and `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, the account registered through `registerApp`, each item saved as a draft in a writable package and published through `publishMetaItem` (6 cases):
   - The registry serves the account with `created_at`, `updated_at`, `owner_id`, `created_by` declared `required: false`; a system-context insert stores both timestamps and `null` in `owner_id` and `created_by`.
   - LIT, flow and hook: both `created_at` / `updated_at` conditions publish (row `active`), and `os build` reports nothing on the same item.
   - LIT, flow and hook: `record.owner_id > 'a'` gets 422 `INVALID_METADATA` with one `expression-invalid` issue naming `record.owner_id`; the row stays `draft`.
   - LIT (S1): a `beforeInsert` hook with `record.created_at > timestamp(…)` gets 422 `INVALID_METADATA` with one `expression-invalid` issue naming `record.created_at`; the row stays `draft`.
3. **Ablations** (one-shot; nothing permanent; each through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore verified blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty):
   - Round 4, at `df63888d` (lint `#33246` 10 cases):
     - M2, the current-row test off (`finding.operand === finding.field || finding.operand === 'record.' + finding.field` replaced by an always-true opaque guard): lint 1 of 10 red, the M2 LIT; a throwaway probe (deleted) split it per site: the `afterInsert` hook and the `record-after-create` flow each red.
     - S2, `beforeFind` / `afterFind` added to `STAMPED_ROW_HOOK_EVENTS`: lint 1 of 10 red, the S2 LIT.
     - S1 again on the new mechanism, `beforeInsert` added to `STAMPED_ROW_HOOK_EVENTS`: lint 1 of 10 red, the S1 LIT.
   - Round 3, at `efc8003b`:
     - M1, the skip on arithmetic operands too (`STAMPED_COMPARISON_OPERATORS.has(finding.operator)` replaced by an always-true opaque guard): lint 1 of 8 `#33246` cases red, the M1 LIT.
     - S1, the `beforeInsert` exception off (`includes('beforeInsert')` → `includes('ABL_33246S1')`): lint 1 of 8 red, the S1 LIT; runtime, after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build` and `ablation-dist-preflight` finding the marker in `dist/`, 1 of 6 red, the S1 LIT. Lint rebuilt after restore; `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` passes on all 20 built files with a clean tree.
   - Round 2, at `ddd834f5` (6 `#33246` lint cases then, 5 runtime cases):
     - A, `main`'s reading (the stamped skip guarded off by an opaque global): lint 1 of 6 red (the created_at / updated_at LIT); runtime via `dist/` 2 of 5 red (the flow and hook LIT).
     - B, the round-1 reading (strip on every runtime write): lint 3 of 6 red (the five-column LIT, the date-arithmetic LIT, the external CONTROL).

## Measurement

Round 1's probe (deleted, not committed) over the real door at `origin/main` `fc283d6d`:

| Condition | Site | Door on `main` | `os build` (real CLI) | `validate_expression` gate half | Door at this head |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `record.created_at > timestamp('2025-01-01T00:00:00Z')` | flow start / edge / branch, hook (every event a stamped-row event) | 422 `expression-invalid` (nullable `created_at`) | exit 0 | clean | published |
| `record.updated_at > record.created_at` | flow start / edge / branch, hook (every event a stamped-row event) | 422, two findings | exit 0 | clean | published |
| `record.created_at > timestamp(…)` | `beforeInsert` hook | 422 | accepted | clean | 422, unchanged (#33435) |
| `record.created_at > timestamp(…)` | `beforeFind` / `afterFind` hook | 422 | accepted | clean | 422, unchanged |
| `record.updated_at > previous.updated_at` | `afterInsert` hook, `record-after-create` flow | 422 (`previous.updated_at`) | accepted | — | 422, unchanged |
| `record.owner_id > 'a'` | flow, hook | 422 (nullable `owner_id`) | exit 0 | clean | 422, unchanged (#33435) |
| `record.created_at + 1 > 0` | hook, action | 422 `date arithmetic` | accepted (`runAuthoringRules('build')`: no type for an injected column) | — | 422, unchanged |
| `record.created_at + 1 > 0` | flow start | 422 (nullable `created_at`) | accepted | — | 422, unchanged |
| `record.amount > 0` (control) | flow edge, hook | 422 | exit 1, the same finding | finding | 422, unchanged |

- `os build` is the real CLI (`packages/cli/bin/run.js build`) on a `defineStack` config with the same object, flows and hooks. `os lint` on it exits 0. The `beforeInsert`, read-event, `previous.` and flow-arithmetic build rows are `runAuthoringRules('build')`, which judges no injected column.
- `validate_expression`'s gate half is `judgeAuthoredSiteExpression` (site `flow_condition`) over the served definition, the call the MCP tool makes; it strips the injected columns, so it stays as it was.
- Engine fact: a system-context insert stores `created_at` and `updated_at` and `null` in `owner_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue` (pinned in the runtime file for `owner_id` and `created_by`). `organization_id`'s injected definition says org scoping stamps it on insert; the door still judges it nullable, as on `main`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Door versus build, still split:** the door judges `owner_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `owning_business_unit_id`, `queue` and `organization_id` nullable, and judges `created_at` / `updated_at` in a `beforeInsert` or read-event hook; the build judges no injected column. #33435 owns that verdict; the changeset says so.
- **Type verdicts:** the build's type index has no injected column (`dyn`), the door's has them. Unchanged by this PR.
- A record-triggered flow's `record.created_at + 1 > 0` is not type-checked at the door on `main` or here (only the bare spelling is); the null guard refuses it, on `main` and here (M1).
- A flow on `record-before-create` binds a `beforeInsert` hook at the default priority (100), after the stamp (10), so the flow sites are not excepted.
- The door has no general gate against a `record.` read in a read-event hook condition (the engine rejects such a read at run time, #4775); S2 only keeps this PR's skip off those hooks. Reported to the seat for a card.
- **Out of scope, unchanged:** a hop leaf through an injected lookup (`record.owner_id.nmae`) is judged at neither door.

## Verification

Head `df63888d` (round 3 `10f6d63a`, round 2 `ddd834f5`, round 1 `533eb60b`; base `fc283d6d`). Round 4 pushes one commit on the same branch, no rebase, no merge: `git diff --stat fc283d6d origin/main` (`e3f0cfd4` at hand-over) over every touched file is empty, and `git merge-tree` with `origin/main` is clean. Everything below ran at `df63888d`.

- `@objectstack/runtime`: the door file 6/6; typecheck (`tsc --noEmit && check:test-typecheck`) exit 0.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (every save, draft-diagnostics and publish door test, lint read through `dist/` rebuilt at this head): 339 files passed, 9 skipped; 22850 tests passed, 43 skipped.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates (dispatch-gates --commands, 63 lines)</summary>

Every line ran with stdin closed and its exit code captured before any pipe. All 63 exited 0 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` included). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

</details>

Dogfood: not run. The title carries no `!` and `Clause-②` carries no `(narrowing)` arm.
